EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

IT is hereby notified that by virtue of powers vested in me under Section 17 of the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235)I, R. Semasinghe, Director General of Customs, determine that with effect from 10th August, 2015, all duties ofCustoms as well as other charges, penalties and forfeitures incurred under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235), shall bepaid and received at the Rates of Exchange set out in the Schedule.

The notification relating to the Rates of Exchange published in Gazette Extraordinary, No. 1926/1 of03rd August, 2015 is hereby rescinded and the said Rates of Exchange are Scheduled to be rescinded by a similarnotification to be published on or before 16th August 2015.
RATES OF EXCHANGE EFFECTIVE FROM 10TH AUGUST 2015 TO 16TH AUGUST 2015
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
